years_checked.2011: Nothing on X or YouTube. Searches for 2011 Freetown flood, rain or landslide returned only 2015-2026 items.
years_checked.2012: Nothing on X or YouTube, including cholera/Kroo Bay phrasings.
years_checked.2013: Nothing on X or YouTube. One search summary claimed an 'August 2013' Freetown flood, but the videos it cited are the Aug 2017 Regent mudslide (indexed about 14-16 Aug 2017); rejected.
years_checked.2016: Nothing on X or YouTube for Freetown. Searches for July, August and September 2016 returned only 2017 mudslide material.
years_checked.2018: No flood event. The only 2018 Freetown items were a Hull City Council post of 20 Sep 2018 (10:33 UTC) about de-silting the Kroo Bay river (mitigation, not a flood) and FCC's June 2018 flood-mitigation launch.

method: WebSearch restricted to x.com, twitter.com and youtube.com (the site: operator was ignored, so the allowed_domains filter was used instead), plus phrase searches. X post times were decoded from post IDs ((id >> 22) + 1288834974657 ms, UTC; Freetown is UTC+0). YouTube upload dates were estimated from the search index's 'days ago' age, which matched known events (e.g. 4085 days -> 16 Sep 2015, 3387 days -> 14 Aug 2017). x.com, youtube.com and all news sites could not be fetched from this session (DNS blocked), so all evidence is from search titles and snippets. The web-search budget (200 per turn, shared with other agents) ran out after about 90 of my searches.

excluded_items.why: Cotton Tree fell during a heavy downpour on the night of 24 May 2023 (post 21:58 UTC). Storm/tree fall, no flood, landslide or wall collapse reported.
Building collapse in Freetown, post 17 Sep 2024 05:30 UTC; the snippet does not link it to rain.
Rocketboom/Humanwire 'Massive Flooding Kroo Bay, Sierra Leone', indexed about 2009 (6,255 days); describes chronic flooding with no event date.
'Helping Flood Victims at Kaningo, Freetown', indexed about 29 Aug 2017 (3,372 days); cannot tell whether it is the 14 Aug or the 26 Aug 2017 flood, so no record.
'Flooding In Freetown', indexed about 16 Sep 2015 (4,085 days); matches the listed 2015-09-16 event, and the snippet text was not verbatim, so it was not used as evidence.
FCC post of 29 Jul 2019 11:00 UTC about clearing the Samba gutter (Hillside By-pass to Pademba Road); mitigation, not a flood.
